message:
Accented titles now keep their base letters: "Crème brûlée recipes" becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`. `npm test` passes all 3 tests.

The fix is one line in `src/blog/slug.js`. It decomposes accented characters (NFD) and removes the combining accent marks before passing the title to `slugify`. I didn't edit `vendor/slugify`, because its header and `vendor/README.md` say never to edit vendored code by hand.

`src/shop/product-url.js` also calls the vendored `slugify` directly, so product names with accents will still lose those letters. I left it alone to keep this change focused. If you want the same behavior there, it would be a one-line change using the same normalization.
